uutiset.t: Racecourse office blown away in Brazil
uutiset.s: A powerful storm shattered windows and sent debris flying inside a racetrack office in Brazil.

uutiset.t: Colombian president taunts arrested supermarket hostage-takers
uutiset.s: Colombia’s president has confronted the men who held 76 people hostage at a Cartagena supermarket.

uutiset.t: Anthropic CEO Amodei denies wanting humanity to ‘surrender’ free will to AI
uutiset.s: Dario Amodei's remarks come amid predictions that AI may soon match or surpass human intelligence.

uutiset.t: FIFA turns to influencers to promote U17 World Cup
uutiset.s: FIFA has enlisted social media influencers to promote the Under-17 World Cup in Qatar.

uutiset.t: Kim Jong Un says North Korea should widen deployment of tactical nukes
uutiset.s: North Korean leader warns attempts to deny country's nuclear status will be seen as "an open declaration of war".

uutiset.t: Photos: Storms and an El Nino-charged king tide batter California’s coast
uutiset.s: Meteorologists have warned that the king tide could pair with high surf to bring historic surges to parts of the state.

uutiset.t: Ukraine attacks Russian military base, says five planes struck
uutiset.s: The Ukrainian General Staff says its forces struck an airbase in the Nizhny Novgorod region east of Moscow.

uutiset.t: ICE officers smash car window, pepper spray bystanders
uutiset.s: Masked ICE agents smashed a car window and forcibly opened its door to arrest a man in California.

uutiset.t: Judges recommend prosecutors end corruption case against Netanyahu
uutiset.s: Israeli judges have ruled there is little prospect Benjamin Netanyahu will be convicted of corruption.

uutiset.t: Storms push Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City to Saturday
uutiset.s: The parade, which marks its 100th edition, got a last-minute rain check ahead of heavy gusts on Thursday.

uutiset.t: ISIL blamed for multiple suicide attacks in Syria
uutiset.s: ISIL suicide attack kills two in an assault on a security post in northeastern Syria.

uutiset.t: Two Syrian security personnel killed in ISIL suicide attack
uutiset.s: Syrian forces say the attack in northeastern Syria's city of Hasakah involved four assailants who were all killed.

uutiset.t: Zambia bans protest against push to remove presidential term limits
uutiset.s: Critics fear the campaign could undermine democratic safeguards as senior opposition figures remain behind bars.

uutiset.t: A meeting with Democrats over healthcare? Trump says he’s open to it
uutiset.s: Experts tell Al Jazeera they are sceptical that Trump would back Medicare for All, a proposal for national healthcare.

uutiset.t: Iran war live: Explosion rocks Sanaa; missiles intercepted over Riyadh
uutiset.s: A blast hits Sanaa after air strikes near the airport, as the Saudi coalition intercepts missiles over Riyadh.
